decision: closedUtcDayWindow(now = new Date()) accepts valid Date objects and returns the previous fully elapsed UTC day as inclusive from and exclusive to ISO timestamps. It does not mutate now; invalid inputs throw TypeError and an unrepresentable previous day throws RangeError.
